name: Dwarf
summary: Stout folk of stone and forge — hardy, traditional, and hard to poison.
abilityScoreIncrease: CON +2 (hill: WIS +1; mountain: STR +2 — pick subrace)
traits:
Darkvision 60 ft.
Dwarven Resilience — advantage on saves vs poison; resistance to poison damage.
Dwarven Combat Training — battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, warhammer.
Tool Proficiency — smith, brewer, or mason tools.
Stonecunning — History checks related to stonework use double proficiency.
Hill: Dwarven Toughness (+1 HP per level).
Mountain: Medium armor proficiency.
notes: Subraces commonly used: hill dwarf, mountain dwarf.
